identity.title: Protected Operator Commands
identity.objective: Add the first default-off authenticated Control Center mutation boundary for exactly five canonical StrategyLifecycle governance commands using durable lifecycle records as receipts/audit, conditional expected-head append for stale-state plus lost-response idempotency, ephemeral in-memory operator bearer sessions and explicit HTTP rereads, while adding no paper, execution-gateway, Hermes/provider, product-network, account, Gate-C, LIVE-ORCH, order, capital or deployment authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert CMD-01. Four command routes, ephemeral command auth, five lifecycle command controls, conditional lifecycle append helper and command contract disappear. Existing lifecycle records remain valid historical canonical evidence; no paper/gateway/order/live state migration exists.
